_doc: Things thrown in a river and carried down it (systems/riverDrift.js; on the street map ui/innerMapRiverDrift.js, drawn by ui/innerMapLayers/riverDrift.js). hoursPerHex: how long the current takes to carry a thing across a hex off the street map (the world clock: day x 24 + the hour). mapSpeed: cells a second it drifts on the street map mid-channel (bankSlow: how much slower at the edges; wander: how far it swings across the channel, in cells; bob: how high it bobs, in art pixels). damAt: how far down the hex's river a weir stands (0 its head, 1 its foot) when nothing else places it. damCap: how many things a dam holds before the rest spill over it. millWeirs: a town's water mill on a river hex weirs it (worlds since millWeirGen). restDays: how long a thing lies in a lake (then sinks) or a pool at a river's end, or washed up on a bank. maxItems: the most adrift in the world at once (the oldest at rest go first). reach: how far (cells) you can lean out and hook a thing from the bank, a ford or a bridge; damReach: from the bank beside a dam. sinkers: goods that go straight to the bottom.
